question: Should OpenClaw continue this Wave 2+ dashboard roadmap as staged bundled Control UI/plugin work, or narrow it to extension APIs and ClawHub-distributed packages?
rationale: The roadmap is aligned with web-frontend ergonomics but crosses bundled-plugin, browser sandbox, persisted state, command binding, sharing, and plugin-distribution boundaries that automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Sponsor staged bundled dashboard work
options.body: Keep the tracker open, review the linked subitems and stacked PRs in dependency order, and require explicit storage/security/API approval per step.

options.title: Narrow to plugin and ClawHub seams
options.body: Keep only missing SDK or Control UI extension seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widgets, skills, and bundles to prove themselves externally first.

options.title: Pause the dashboard roadmap
options.body: Defer the umbrella and close or freeze the linked implementation stack until maintainers want bundled dashboard work in the product cycle.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged bundled dashboard work
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker open, review the linked subitems and stacked PRs in dependency order, and require explicit storage/security/API approval per step.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the recent Logbook/plugin-tab seam that the roadmap builds on.
